summary.en-US: Offline Chinese-English dictionary from Wiktionary data

description.en-US:
An offline Chinese-English dictionary. Results update on every keystroke;
search by simplified or traditional characters, by pinyin with or without
tone digits, or by English words in the definitions. Tap a result to see
all of its senses.

The dictionary is the Chinese section of English Wiktionary as extracted
by wiktextract and published on kaikki.org (about 190,000 entries). The
whole index ships inside the APK, so the app needs no network access.

Licensing: the app code is MIT licensed. The dictionary data is derived
from Wiktionary and is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (and GFDL); credit goes
to the Wiktionary contributors (https://en.wiktionary.org/) and to
kaikki.org (https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Chinese/).
